grade_reason: No statement by Chris Stigall about AI, in his own words, was found from 1 January 2025 onward. He has never held office, so he could not have sponsored or co-sponsored the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act.
notes: Seven web searches ran; none was refused. He has no official site, and the searches turned up no campaign issues page that mentions AI. The KCUR voter guide (6 October 2026) and the Spectrum News Q&A (20 August 2026) were opened; neither has him saying anything about AI, data centers or technology (topics: rural health care, farm bill, tariffs, Second Amendment, SAVE America Act). His Salem podcast ran a 27 November 2025 episode 'Thanksgiving Special: AI, Justice, and the Future of America' with guest Marc Beckman on AI's effects on jobs, national security and identity (https://salempodcastnetwork.com/podcasts/the-chris-stigall-podcast/thanksgiving-special-ai-justice-and-the-future-of-america); the episode page quotes nothing he said, and the audio was not checked. As a former daily talk radio host he may well have discussed AI on air, but no transcript was found, so the search is incomplete for broadcast remarks.
